title: Cricket Scoreboard (Cricbuzz)
description: Design a Cricbuzz-style live scorecard (Udaan's machine-coding round): parse each ball into a value object, apply it to the innings, rotate strike and overs, and publish to listeners and immutable live snapshots, in Java, Python and C++14.

hero.html:
Level 3 - Intermediate Read 55 minBuild 90 min Machine-coding case study Patterns: Observer, State, Value Object

Cricket Scoreboard (Cricbuzz)

Udaan's take-home classic: feed a match in ball by ball (runs, wides, no-balls, wickets), keep strike and extras right, print every batter's line after each over and announce the winner. You get the domain model (Match, Innings, Ball, stats), the two state machines, live updates through Observer, running Java, Python and C++14 code that reproduces the Udaan sample, and the follow-ups interviewers add.
